info.title: PaySubscriptions API
info.description: Versioned REST API for User-owned resources (v1).

parameters.name: chartMode
parameters.description: Chart view: twelve-month charge distribution (bar), monthly doughnut (monthly), or yearly doughnut (yearly). Defaults to bar.

parameters.name: basis
parameters.description: Direct-cycle charges (direct) or normalized equivalents (equivalent). The bar view supports direct only; monthly equivalent uses per-Subscription monthly calculations over all reportable Subscriptions; yearly equivalent uses yearly calculations. Defaults to direct.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Optional User-owned ExpenseCategory UUID filter; omit for all categories. An unknown or foreign UUID matches nothing and renders an empty report.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month of the year (1-12) used only by the monthly direct view. Any other use, or a value outside 1-12, is a validation error.

get.summary: Retrieves the collection of ExpenseCategory resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of ExpenseCategory resources.

get.summary: Retrieves the collection of Subscription resources.
get.description: Retrieves the collection of Subscription resources.

parameters.name: order[name]
parameters.description: Sort by subscription name ("asc" or "desc"). Only one "order[field]" parameter may be sent at a time (otherwise 422). Default sort is name/asc, ties broken by name then id.

parameters.name: order[price]
parameters.description: Sort by comparable price ("asc" or "desc"). Only one "order[field]" parameter may be sent at a time (otherwise 422). Default sort is name/asc, ties broken by name then id.

parameters.name: order[renewal]
parameters.description: Sort by next renewal date ("asc" or "desc"). Only one "order[field]" parameter may be sent at a time (otherwise 422). Default sort is name/asc, ties broken by name then id.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by ExpenseCategory UUID. A malformed UUID is a 422 on "category"; an unknown or foreign UUID matches nothing.

DashboardReport.description: Current dashboard snapshot: summary cards plus one chart mode. Stateless snapshot of the authenticated User's Subscriptions reusing the web dashboard calculations. Summary mirrors SubscriptionService::getTotals() plus the User limit; chart series mirror ChartService numeric data with basis/visibility metadata instead of Chart.js options. Pending-review cross-currency Subscriptions stay in counts but are excluded from monetary totals and charts. The month selector applies only to the monthly direct view (monthly Subscriptions plus yearly ones whose next-payment month matches). No year, date-range, payment-history, or forecast semantics.
